# L1 → L2 Contrastive Profile — `<L1 name>` → `<L2 name>` (`<l1>`→`<l2>`)

> **What this is.** Everything about learning this **specific pair** that depends on the mother
> tongue: what transfers, what interferes, what's hard *for this L1 in particular*, and how to phrase
> meanings. One per L1 for a given L2. Output of Step 1; consumed by Step 2. Read alongside the L2
> Language Profile — this document only covers what *changes with the L1*.
>
> Answer every section; use "n/a — <reason>" rather than deleting. Delete these blockquotes when filling.
